narrative.intro: Palmetto Gba obligated $324M in FY2026 to date across 14 awards. Palmetto Gba's average award size is $23.2M, and obligations were down 14.8% year over year. The Department of Health and Human Services is the dominant buyer, obligating $308M so far in FY2026. Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers is the largest NAICS market for Palmetto Gba with $271M in obligations. Other notable NAICS markets include Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services at $23.1M and Administration of Human Resource Programs (except Education, Public Health, and Veterans' Affairs Programs) at $17M. Historical obligations show variation: FY21 was $351M, FY22 was $265M, FY23 was $372M, FY24 was $264M, and FY25 was $381M. Palmetto Gba also records obligations in All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services at $12.4M and Exam Preparation and Tutoring at $1.1M. The FY2026 totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and the dataset summarizes obligations by agency and NAICS for that period.

sections.heading: Who are Palmetto Gba's main federal customers?
sections.body: The Department of Health and Human Services is the primary customer, obligating $308M in FY2026 to date. The Railroad Retirement Board is a secondary buyer with $16.2M in obligations. No other agencies are listed among the top buyers for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: Which industries capture most of Palmetto Gba's federal obligations?
sections.body: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers captures the largest share with $271M in FY2026 to date. Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services accounts for $23.1M, and Administration of Human Resource Programs (except Education, Public Health, and Veterans' Affairs Programs) accounts for $17M. Smaller markets include All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services at $12.4M and Exam Preparation and Tutoring at $1.1M.

faq.q: How much does Palmetto Gba make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Palmetto Gba has obligated $324M in FY2026 to date. Palmetto Gba won 14 awards so far this fiscal year with an average award size of $23.2M, and obligations were down 14.8% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Palmetto Gba?
faq.a: The Department of Health and Human Services buys most from Palmetto Gba, obligating $308M in FY2026 to date. The Railroad Retirement Board is the next listed buyer with $16.2M in obligations.

faq.q: What does Palmetto Gba sell to the government?
faq.a: Palmetto Gba primarily sells services to the health insurance and computing markets. Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers accounts for $271M, Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services accounts for $23.1M, and Administration of Human Resource Programs (except Education, Public Health, and Veterans' Affairs Programs) accounts for $17M.
